data.name: NavRecord
data.comment: Top navigation. The predecessor called this tab "Spy"; plan §0 renames it.

data.name: NavSettings
data.comment: Top navigation.

data.name: NavAdvanced
data.comment: Top navigation.

data.name: RecordStatusIdle
data.comment: Shown above the activity log before a session starts.

data.name: RecordStatusWaiting
data.value: Waiting for Spotify to play something.
data.comment: Status line while a session is running but no track has started.

data.name: RecordStatusRecording
data.comment: Status line while audio is being captured.

data.name: RecordStatusStopping
data.comment: Status line while the encode queue drains after Stop. Stopping is not instant.

data.name: RecordStart
data.comment: The transport button when idle. Same verb as the status it produces.

data.name: RecordStop
data.comment: The transport button while a session runs.

data.name: RecordNothingPlaying
data.comment: Stands in for the track name when Spotify has no track on screen.

data.name: RecordLevelLabel
data.comment: Accessible name for the waveform. Screen readers get this; sighted users get the bars.

data.name: RecordCannotStartSettings
data.value: Settings could not be read, so recording did not start. Fix or delete the settings file and try again.
data.comment: Start failed. Recording on defaults would write to a folder the user never chose.

data.name: RecordCannotStartFfmpeg
data.value: ffmpeg was not found. Set its location on the Settings page, then start again.
data.comment: Start failed. Every conversion goes through ffmpeg, so there is no degraded mode.

data.name: RecordCannotStartAudioDevice
data.value: The audio device could not be opened. Check it is still connected, then start again.
data.comment: Start failed, usually a device unplugged since it was chosen in settings.

data.name: RecordFilterLabel
data.comment: Label for the activity log's level filter.

data.name: RecordFilterAll
data.comment: Log filter: no filtering, including debug detail.

data.name: RecordFilterActivity
data.comment: Log filter: information and above. The default — what the app is doing, without the detail.

data.name: RecordFilterProblems
data.comment: Log filter: warnings and errors.

data.name: RecordCopyLog
data.comment: Button that copies the visible log lines to the clipboard.

data.name: RecordLogCopied
data.comment: Logged after Copy log. {0} is the number of lines copied.

data.name: RecordClearLog
data.comment: Button that empties the activity log.

data.name: PageEmpty
data.comment: Placeholder for a page whose controls have not been built.
